title: Density one for closed and open balls from a flat tangent measure (parent Steps 1–2)
statement: Let m ≥ 1, μ a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^{m+1} = Euclid (m+1), and y, v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with ‖v‖ = 1. Put P := (span{v})^⊥ and H^m := μHE[m]. Assume μ(B̄_{r₀}(y)) < ∞ for some r₀ > 0, and that for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ, r^{-m} ∫ f(r^{-1}(z − y)) dμ(z) → ∫_P f dH^m as r ↓ 0. Then, as r ↓ 0, μ(B̄_r(y))/(ω_m r^m) → 1 and μ(B_r(y))/(ω_m r^m) → 1 in [0, ∞], where ω_m = unitBallVolume m and both denominators are unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m). (These are exactly the first two conjuncts of the parent conclusion, under the parent's hypotheses.)
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → ‖v‖ = 1 → (∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ μ (closedBall y r₀) ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {v})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), f z ∂μHE[m]))) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
